newsitem.title: FRANCE: France aims to privatise Cr Lyonnais in two years.
newsitem.headline: France aims to privatise Cr Lyonnais in two years.

text.p: France intends to knock state bank Credit Lyonnais into shape to privatise it in two years, a finance ministry spokeswoman said on Friday.

The spokeswoman also said the finance ministry would hold off on submitting a rescue plan for the bank to the European Commission for approval until the end of March as it looked for ways to limit the drain on public funds.

The rescue plan, the third in four years, had been expected to be lodged in Brussels this week. The spokeswoman said that the decision to delay presentation of the plan had been taken in full accord with European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert.

"Both want to limit the amount of public money" needed for the bank," she said, adding that Van Miert wanted to ensure the the package respected EU competition rules and "Jean Arthuis wants to respect the interests of French taxpapers".
She added that the aim of the plan would be to have the bank, whose woes stem from an expansion spree in the late 1980s, "in a state ready to privatise in two years from now."
